method: Built-in image_gen transparent reference edits; original generated atlases preserved byte-for-byte. Native TEXTURES registration clips frames without modifying pixels.
author_request: Dedicated sustained exhalation gesture for Mandinga and Zupay.

prompts.mandinga: Create a production-ready transparent sprite atlas for the Mandinga demon shown in the attached original game sprites. Preserve his exact character design: lean humanoid, dark red-black skin, small curved horns, red eyes, long black coat, red neck scarf, dark trousers and boots, dagger lowered in one hand. Detailed gritty dark-fantasy pixel-compatible painted game sprite, same materials and proportions as reference. This is a NEW dedicated sustained FIRE EXHALATION bodily animation, NOT the standing pose: he leans his upper torso and head slightly forward, opens his mouth clearly as if blowing a forceful jet, shoulders braced and abdomen/chest subtly contracting. Hands are lowered, not casting spells. DO NOT paint emitted flames, smoke, particles, floor or shadows; the engine will add a separate flame exactly at the mouth. Keep the mouth at a fixed height and horizontal head offset throughout animation. Entire body including boots and horns in every cell. Atlas EXACTLY 8 columns by 4 rows = 32 separate full-body sprites. Columns from left to right: front toward viewer, front three-quarter facing screen left, pure side facing screen left, rear three-quarter facing screen left, rear away from viewer, rear three-quarter facing screen right, pure side facing screen right, front three-quarter facing screen right. Every row repeats these same eight directions. Rows are four subtle consecutive phases of the SAME sustained exhalation with open mouth in all four, forming a seamless loop through controlled chest/shoulder/clothing motion; no inhale or recovery phase. Fixed feet and head pivots, consistent body scale across every cell, generous completely transparent horizontal and vertical gutters with no touching figures. Crisp isolated alpha edges, transparent RGBA canvas, no text, numbers, grid, captions or extra objects. Wide 2:1 sprite-sheet composition.
prompts.zupay: Create a production-ready transparent sprite atlas for the Zupay colossus demon shown in the attached original game sprites. Preserve this exact huge muscular bull-goat humanoid monster: enormous swept curved black horns, obsidian dark hide with pale mottled stone-like markings and glowing orange fissures, red-orange eyes, broad snout, fangs, dark fur mane, gold wrist bands and belt, red-dark loincloth and powerful cloven hooves. Detailed gritty dark-fantasy painted game sprites matching the originals. This is a NEW dedicated sustained FIRE EXHALATION bodily animation: feet firmly planted, torso and head leaning forward a little, mouth unmistakably open to blow fire, shoulders braced, abdomen/chest contracting subtly. Empty lowered hands, no boulder and no weapon. DO NOT paint flames, smoke, sparks, ground or shadows; the engine adds separate emitted fire at the mouth. Keep the mouth at fixed height and forward offset throughout the animation. Whole body including hooves and horn tips in each cell. Atlas EXACTLY 8 columns by 4 rows = 32 separated full-body sprites. Columns left to right: front toward viewer; front three-quarter facing screen left; pure side facing screen left; rear three-quarter facing screen left; back away from viewer; rear three-quarter facing screen right; pure side facing screen right; front three-quarter facing screen right. These eight rotations repeat in every row, including true rear/back views. Rows are four consecutive subtle phases of ONE sustained exhalation with mouth open in every phase, seamless loop using chest/shoulder motion, fixed feet/head anchors and consistent scale. Generous fully transparent row and column gutters: all figures isolated, nothing touching adjacent frames. Transparent RGBA background, crisp alpha, NO text, numbers, captions, grid lines or extra objects. Wide 2:1 atlas composition.
